slides.sub: Six years that ask you to step forward.

slides.body: Dasha (a planetary period in the Vimshottari system) is a season, not a sentence. The Sun signifies authority, identity and recognition, so this season raises questions of leadership and credit.

points: Taking ownership of a visible project
Dealing with bosses, government or institutions
Being judged on results, not effort
Ego and identity coming into focus

slides.body: Visibility can tempt you to chase approval. A weak or afflicted Sun may show as a hunger for credit; a strong one, as steady, earned authority.
Results depend on the Sun's sign, house, dignity and the rest of the chart. This is a planning lens, not a prediction.
